epistemic_thesis: Obligatory calibrated nostalgia & homonymous ontological discontinuity: Maurilia invites the traveler to compare its gleaming present metropolis against faded provincial postcards and praise a 'lost grace' within strict rules—yet that grace never existed when Maurilia was actually provincial (appearing only retroactively by metropolitan contrast), and beneath the identical name MAURILIA, the postcard town and present metropolis are two completely unrelated successive cities whose old gods departed without a word while outsiders settled in their place.

stones.provincial_stone: Speckled hen pecking in the dusty provincial square
stones.metropolis_stone: Gleaming cantilevered glass bus station & transit concourse
stones.calvino_correspondence: The identical square with a hen taking the place of the bus station

stones.provincial_stone: Filigree wrought-iron bandstand in the municipal garden
stones.calvino_correspondence: A bandstand taking the place of the overpass

stones.provincial_stone: Two young ladies strolling with white lace parasols
stones.metropolis_stone: Munitions factory smokestacks, foundry bays & shift gate
stones.calvino_correspondence: Two young ladies with white parasols taking the place of the munitions factory

obligatory_nostalgia_band.rule: The traveler must praise the postcard city and prefer it to the present metropolis, but strictly contain regret within rules: acknowledging metropolitan magnificence/prosperity while mourning a lost grace visible ONLY now in old postcards.

retroactive_grace_paradox.from_metropolis_vantage: When viewed through the postcard loupe against the gleaming metropolis with calibrated regret in [0.52, 0.78], retroactiveGrace rises to >= 0.72 (warm sepia collodion halation & phantom brass waltz).
retroactive_grace_paradox.real_time_1906_mode: When inspected directly in Real-Time 1906 Mode (provincial Maurilia before one's eyes, without metropolitan contrast), retroactiveGrace collapses to 0.00—revealing flat, muddy, ungraceful provincial tedium.

departed_gods_discontinuity.surface_homonymy: Site coordinates, city name MAURILIA, inhabitants' surnames, vocal accents, and facial profiles show continuity = 1.00.
departed_gods_discontinuity.ontological_chasm: Beneath names and above places, ontologicalConnection = 0.00: the old gods departed without a word, outsiders settled in their niches, and the postcards depict a wholly different city called Maurilia only by chance.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive Stereopticon & Retroactive-Grace Optical Comparator with WebAudio Transit/Phantom-Brass Crossfade & Subterranean/Celestial Departed-Gods Stratum

maurilia-archivist.responsibility: Halftone sepia postcard renderer, speckled hen / wrought-iron bandstand / white-lace parasol vignettes, stereoscopic <postcard-loupe> clipping & postmark framing, and retroactive-grace computation that peaks in metropolitan comparison and vanishes to 0.00 in real-time 1906 mode.

maurilia-engineer.responsibility: Gleaming present metropolis canvas (glass bus station concourse, concrete viaduct overpass, munitions factory shift & smokestacks), departed-gods subterranean/celestial cutaway & discontinuity meter (ontologicalConnection = 0.00), and procedural WebAudio engine crossfading transit/siren ambience with phantom 1906 brass-band halftone crackle.

maurilia-weaver.responsibility: Bundles layers/provincial_postcards.js and layers/unrelated_metropolis.js into a standalone zero-dependency index.html (0 http/https, 0 ../, J_dom < 0.35 via custom DOM vocabulary & .mrl-* selectors, 1280x800 & 390x844 responsive, full keyboard & prefers-reduced-motion, plus <maurilia-plate-drawer> [P] displaying local map.png & image.png with graceful map.svg/inline SVG onerror fallback).

maurilia-critic.responsibility: Blindfolded adversarial verifier auditing HG-1..HG-4 via headless browser & Python/Node checks (standalone hygiene, J_dom morphology, all 6 stones across 3 loci, retroactive-grace vanishing to 0 in 1906 mode, departed-gods discontinuity, 1280x800 & 390x844 layout, and Royal Plate Guild map.png/map.svg/image.png once on disk).

royal_plates_external_guild.note: Do NOT spawn cartographer or limner workers; weaver wires src='map.png' and src='image.png' with graceful fallback immediately.

hard_gates.HG-1: Standalone Capsule & Anti-Trude Morphology: index.html self-contained, 0 http(s):// URLs, 0 ../ imports, 100% bespoke custom element tags (including all 6 required tags) & .mrl-* CSS classes yielding J_dom < 0.35, 0 runtime errors.
hard_gates.HG-2: Complete Calvino Stones & Audio-Visual Craft: All 3 spatial loci pairing (1) speckled hen <-> glass bus station, (2) wrought-iron bandstand <-> concrete viaduct overpass, (3) two young ladies with white lace parasols <-> munitions factory smokestacks; procedural WebAudio transit/phantom-brass synthesis + prefers-reduced-motion compliance.
hard_gates.HG-3: Inner Arch Causality & Blind Recognition: (a) Calibrated regret in [0.52, 0.78] from metropolis vantage yields high retroactiveGrace (>= 0.72), whereas excessive or vulgar praise triggers citizen admonition; (b) toggling Real-Time 1906 Mode collapses retroactiveGrace to 0.00 and strips sepia charm into drab ungraceful provincial reality; (c) Departed-Gods probe demonstrates surface homonymy (1.0) vs ontological connection (0.0) between two unrelated Maurilias; title-masked inspection unmistakably identifies Cities & Memory 5.
hard_gates.HG-4: Responsive Ergonomics & Royal Plate Drawer: Zero clipped controls or unwanted scrollbars at 1280x800 and 390x844; full keyboard navigation (1-3, L, T, Arrow keys, G, F, M, P, Z, Escape); <maurilia-plate-drawer> displays map.png & image.png cleanly once Royal Plate Guild III lands them on disk.
